_comment: #457. One entry per task-creation site (xTaskCreate* incl. Static/WithCaps, pd::createTaskPreferPsram, std::thread/jthread) in src/ and main/; task_stack_gate.py fails when a file's site count differs from its entry count. 'entry' is a regex over the call-graph function name, and the worst match is budgeted. 'line' is a reference only. entry=null marks a site that is counted but not walked. 'variants' lists the esp_main files whose image links a row's code, when that is not every image; other images skip the row.
_frame_allowlist: substring of a function's name -> reason. It lifts only the per-frame checks (ceiling, dynamic frame, library callee with no frame); the frame still counts in every chain budget. Bytes are Xtensa, from the #457 run on #685 @ ebdc919.

frame_allowlist.sdp::parse(: 3488 B: `out = Session{}` (Sdp.re:287) builds a temporary sdp::Session on the stack to reset the output; a Session is ~3.3 KB (two are 0x19f0 B, Sdp.hpp)
frame_allowlist.SmtpDialogue::run(: 3408 B: uint8_t chunk[3072] attachment read buffer (SmtpDialogue.cpp:720); runs on smtp_worker, 12288 B
frame_allowlist.UdpServer::receiveLoop(: 2176 B: char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE] (2048 B) datagram buffer (UdpServer.cpp:182); runs on udp_receiver_task, 16384 B
frame_allowlist.FatFsSource::listMessages(: 1888 B: char tombstoned[20][48] (960 B) + char line[512] + char idxPath[160] (VoicemailArchive.cpp:299-314)
frame_allowlist.RequestsHandler::loadVoicemailGreeting(: 1296 B: uint8_t head[1024] WAV header probe (RequestsHandler.cpp:2794)
frame_allowlist.SipTrunk::handleResponse(: 1280 B: no local array in the source; std::string/shared_ptr temporaries and inlined callees
frame_allowlist.GoogleServiceAuth::signRs256(: 1232 B: unsigned char sig[MBEDTLS_PK_SIGNATURE_MAX_SIZE] + mbedtls_pk_context + hash[32] (GoogleServiceAuth.cpp:56-80)
frame_allowlist.SipTrunk::handleBye(: 1184 B: no local array in the source; std::string/shared_ptr temporaries and inlined callees
frame_allowlist.HoldMusic::loadClip(: 1088 B: uint8_t head[1024] WAV header probe (HoldMusic.cpp:286)
frame_allowlist.RequestsHandler::onRefer(: 1056 B: no local array in the source; std::string temporaries for Refer-To/Replaces parsing and inlined callees

_library_defaults: regex over a library callee's name -> bytes charged when the .ci has no frame for it. A reachable library callee with no frame, no match here and no frame_allowlist entry fails the gate.
